project_name: La Isla Nublar LATAM - Tienda de Skins (Skins Store Redesign)
archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & COLLECTIBLE SHOWCASE (Oscuro, Elegante, Dorado, Vitrina Premium)
context: e-commerce (In-app cosmetic showcase inside dark dino-survival gaming community platform)
target_audience: Spanish-speaking gaming community for The Isle: Evrima looking for rare, high-prestige dinosaur cosmetics

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1_title: font-display font-black uppercase tracking-tighter text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl leading-none
hierarchy.h2_hero: font-display font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl leading-tight
hierarchy.h3_section: font-display font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight text-2xl sm:text-3xl
hierarchy.h4_card_title: font-display font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-lg sm:text-xl
hierarchy.subtitle: text-sm sm:text-base text-muted-foreground max-w-2xl leading-relaxed
hierarchy.label_overline: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-amber-400/90 font-bold

rules: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for Main and Sub-headings. Use Outfit / Display heavy weights.
Always pair display titles with golden monospace overlines.
Main titles must use linear gradient gold text clips: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-200 via-amber-400 to-amber-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent.

colors.palette_type: Dark Obsidian + Royal Amber Gold + Rarity Layer

layout_and_grids.container: max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-10

hero_section.structure: Featured Hero Banner showcase at top (min-h-[440px] lg:min-h-[480px])
hero_section.bg_style: relative rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-amber-500/30 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#12151f] via-[#0b0d12] to-[#050608] p-6 sm:p-10 shadow-[0_20px_80px_-20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.25)]

filter_bar.structure: Glassmorphism sticky floating control strip (p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#0d0f14]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-amber-500/20 shadow-xl)
filter_bar.layout: flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4

gallery_grid.grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-5 lg:gap-6

featured_hero_banner.badge: Inline flex item with Sparkles icon + GOLD gradient border + text-amber-300 ('DESTACADO LEGENDARIO DE LA SEMANA')
featured_hero_banner.title: Massive display title with golden text clip
featured_hero_banner.dino_badge: Chip showing dinosaur species (e.g. Tyrannosaurus Rex, Spinosaurus)
featured_hero_banner.countdown_timer: Monospace clock container showing time remaining for limited skin
featured_hero_banner.price_box: Prominent golden pill tag ($11.49 / $12.99 USD) with Stripe quick checkout CTA button
featured_hero_banner.visual_render: High-res dino skin image floating with subtle y-axis floating animation and golden radial spotlight backlight

gallery_card_grid.aspect_ratio: aspect-[3/4] or aspect-[4/5] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border relative group
gallery_card_grid.surface: Dark obsidian slate background (#0d0f14) with rarity border tint (border-[color]/40)
gallery_card_grid.hover_state: Slight lift -translate-y-2, golden/rarity ambient glow expansion, diagonal light sheen sweep across image
gallery_card_grid.top_badges: Rarity tag with Zap icon on left, 'Tuya' green badge on right if owned
gallery_card_grid.bottom_slab: Solid dark gradient background, dino skin name, species tag, and bold price pill tag with rarity color fill

gallery_card_list.layout: Horizontal row (h-20 sm:h-24) rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-[#0d0f14]/80 hover:bg-[#12151f] p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 transition-all duration-200
gallery_card_list.left_thumb: Thumbnail square image with rarity gradient background glow
gallery_card_list.right_action: Price tag + 'Ver / Comprar' button or 'Equipada' status

skin_detail_modal.dialog: max-w-4xl p-0 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-amber-500/40 bg-[#0a0c10] shadow-[0_0_80px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)]
skin_detail_modal.split: 2-column grid on desktop (Left: 3D or 2D floating dino render preview; Right: Luxury details, stats, perks, countdown & Stripe checkout CTA)

rarity_animations_and_effects.gpu_friendly_rules: Use CSS compositor-driven keyframe animations (transform, opacity, background-position) to prevent WebSocket re-render performance drops

css_keyframes.goldGlowPulse: @keyframes goldGlowPulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(1.05); } }

rarity_animations_and_effects.holographic_sheen_technique: Linear gradient angle overlay at 115deg with background-size: 200% 100% animated continuously on legendary/mythic cards
rarity_animations_and_effects.particle_field: CSS keyframe floating gold sparkles specks backdrop layer behind featured hero and legendary detail modal

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign TiendaSkins.jsx, SkinCard.jsx, GalleryCard.jsx, and SkinDetailModal.jsx to implement this luxury dark+gold collectible vitrina theme.
Preserve all state hooks, WebSocket updates, filters, search, view toggle, Stripe checkout API calls (api.shopCheckout), and equip API calls (api.shopEquip).
Implement the Featured Hero Banner at the top of the catalog pulling the top legendary skin ('Toxic Abyss' or first item marked/sorted as featured/legendary).
Add GPU-friendly CSS animations (holographic sweep, gold ambient glow, mythic aura pulse) in index.css or inline CSS keyframes.
Ensure all interactive elements retain their exact data-testid attributes for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark colors as flat gradients; layer obsidian surfaces with delicate amber border strokes and golden spot radial lighting.
Maintain high text contrast for readability over dark backgrounds (WCAG AA).
Include hover states, focus states, and transitions for every button and card.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
